svg.title: Parchi
svg.desc: Case file for Parchi, built for Google Build with AI 2026. A pesticide dealer's chit for tomato, stamped with the verdict, do not spray this, which cycles through 11 Indian languages. A farmer photographs the dealer's chit; Gemini reads it, a rule engine checks every product against India's pesticide register, and the verdict is spoken in their language. The model reads and explains. It never decides.
